title: Configuration Management
use_cases: Open config file in external editor
Manage auth credentials (github-oauth, gitlab-oauth, http-basic, bearer, forgejo-token, bitbucket-oauth)
Manage package properties (name, type, description, keywords, license, extra, suggest, scripts)
include_extend_relationships: Set configuration value <<include>> Validate setting value
Set configuration value <<include>> Normalize setting value
Set configuration value <<include>> Write to JsonConfigSource
Get configuration value <<include>> Read from Config
Manage global configuration <<extend>> Set configuration value
Manage global configuration <<extend>> Get configuration value
Manage auth credentials <<include>> Write to JsonConfigSource
Open config file in external editor <<extend>> Manage global configuration

BaseConfigCommand: initialize(): creates Config via Factory::createConfig(), sets up configFile (JsonFile) and configSource (JsonConfigSource)
getComposerConfigFile(): returns global config.json or local composer.json or --file path
getAuthConfigFile(): returns auth.json path (global or local)
ConfigCommand: initialize(): calls parent, then sets up authConfigFile + authConfigSource (JsonConfigSource with authConfig=true)
execute(): routes to open-editor / list / get / set / unset based on input options and setting-key
handleSingleValue(key, callbacks, values, method): validates + normalizes single value, calls configSource->method()
handleMultiValue(key, callbacks, values, method): validates + normalizes array value, calls configSource->method()
listConfiguration(): recursively prints config tree to output
Config: Holds merged configuration from multiple sources
get(key, flags): returns resolved config value
all(): returns all config as array
merge(data, source): merges new config data with source path tracking
getSourceOfValue(key): returns file path where value was set
setBaseDir(dir): sets base directory for relative path resolution
JsonConfigSource: addConfigSetting(name, value): writes config[name]=value to JSON file; handles nested auth/policy paths
removeConfigSetting(name): removes config key; cascades empty policy ancestors
addRepository(name, config, append): adds/updates repository entry; normalises list format
insertRepository(name, config, referenceName, offset): inserts repo relative to another
setRepositoryUrl(name, url): updates URL of existing repository
addProperty(name, value): writes top-level or nested extra./scripts. property
removeProperty(name): removes top-level or nested property
addLink(type, name, value): writes require/conflict/provide etc.
removeLink(type, name): removes a package link
manipulateJson() [private]: uses JsonManipulator for clean in-place edit; falls back to full rewrite + schema validation

key_relationships: ConfigCommand depends_on JsonConfigSource (writes config settings, properties, repositories)

flow_summary.get_value: Developer runs `composer config <key>` → ConfigCommand.execute() reads configFile, calls config->all() / config->get() / configFile->read(), outputs value
flow_summary.set_value: Developer runs `composer config <key> <value>` → ConfigCommand.execute() validates/normalizes → calls configSource->addConfigSetting() or addProperty() or addRepository() → JsonConfigSource.manipulateJson() edits JSON file
flow_summary.unset_value: Developer runs `composer config --unset <key>` → calls configSource->removeConfigSetting() / removeProperty() / removeRepository()
flow_summary.global_mode: --global flag redirects all reads/writes to ~/.composer/config.json instead of local composer.json
flow_summary.auth_credentials: Auth keys (github-oauth etc.) are routed to authConfigSource (auth.json) instead of configSource

important_notes: ConfigCommand supports --global for global ~/.composer/config.json vs local composer.json. Auth credentials (github-oauth, gitlab-token, http-basic, bearer, forgejo-token, bitbucket-oauth) are stored in auth.json via a separate JsonConfigSource instance. JsonConfigSource uses JsonManipulator for clean in-place JSON editing with fallback to full rewrite + LAX schema validation on every write.
